ops.title: Cleanup busy deletion must force one worker even at the governor rate
ops.description: Owner: Yasyf Mohamedali. Next step: force workers=1 whenever a busy deletion runs and independently take the lower rate. Evidence at 60eefaf1b: engine.go:1186-1189 changes workers only when Busy.Rate < governor rate; DefaultTuning at lines 132-133 uses rate 4000 and four workers. BusyRate >=4000 therefore runs four removals in flight despite docs/worktree-cleanup.md:414-416. Source-only review; no tests ran.

ops.text: Busy rates below, equal to, and above the governor rate all use one worker and the minimum applicable positive rate.
Open-gate deletion retains its configured worker count and root rate caps continue to apply.
